section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1997
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1997 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.6.2 Month-wise distribution of `Road Accidents' also reported higher no. of accidents during May and June. Maximum `Rail-Road Accidents' occurred in the month of March. The maximum number of `Other Railway Accidents' were reported during the months of August and October.
